title: Upstream availability of the model families this estate measures

freshness.rule: as_of is the date the vendor's pages were read, carried by the corpus; it is never the time this request was served

what: What the vendor itself says about which of its model families are available on its API, which are retired, and which have not been released. Read from the vendor's own documentation on the date in as_of, and kept as bytes so the claim can be re-read.
not_this: Not a measurement by us. Every row here is the vendor's own statement about its own surface, read on one date, exactly as the enforcement corpus carries regulator actions as REPORTED rather than MEASURED.
Not a ranking, an endorsement or a judgement of any model. Availability says a model can still be called; it says nothing about how a model behaves.
Not a freshness claim. as_of is the date the vendor's pages were read, never the time this file was served, and it never moves on its own.
Not a statement that a model is good, safe, compliant or approved. Verification of a signed measurement is free and separate; see /gspc-verify/.

carries: MiniMax M2.5 and M2.7 Model Retirement Notice
the release date of each family

status_vocabulary.AVAILABLE: The vendor lists the family under Available Models on the date read.
status_vocabulary.RETIRED: The vendor lists the family under Retired Models on the date read.
status_vocabulary.NOT_RELEASED: No identifier, no release date and no release entry. Nothing is known about this family beyond a public commitment to a future generation, so no number is published for it here.

retirement_notice.quote: As we roll out newer models, we'll be retiring the MiniMax M2.5 and M2.7 model families.

schedule.what: These models are no longer available to new users. M Plan and Token Plan requests are routed to M3.1 Flash from this date; the old model names keep working for backward compatibility.
These models are retired. Pay-as-you-go API requests to them stop working.

retirement_notice.note: The vendor's Retired Models table lists both families as Retired on the date read, and the notice above sets 2026-11-18 as the date pay-as-you-go access ends. Both facts are recorded; neither is resolved here.

upstream_caveats.note: The vendor's model list also covers video, speech, image and music families. This estate's signed model corpus measures language models on frozen banks, so those families are named here and carry no measurement.

coverage.zero_is_measured: every count here is derived from the two committed corpora at their own as_of. A zero is an observed absence in those bytes, not an unmeasured cell defaulted to zero.
